translations.web: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
translations.bsb: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
translations.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
translations.asv: The lamp of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
